bodyHtml:
If you or someone you love is struggling with drug addiction, you can get help at qualified heroin addiction treatment in Huntington Beach, CA. Managing symptoms and overcoming addiction doesn’t have to be tackled alone.

What is Heroin?

Heroin is categorized as a depressant. It is a type of drug that slows down the responses between your brain and your nervous system. Heroin is fast-acting, so they immediately get pain relief and feel better as soon as someone takes it. But, it can be very easy to become addicted to heroin as your body adapts to it, and eventually, you might find it next to impossible to operate normally without it.

What are the Signs of Heroin Use?

If you believe that you or someone in your family needs heroin addiction rehab, there are many signs you can look out for. The signs of heroin addiction will vary from one person to another depending on how much they use, what other drugs they use, if any, and their genes, but in general, you might notice things like:

  • Depression
  • Euphoria
  • Agitation
  • Irritability
  • Mood swings
  • Anxiety
  • Hostility toward those around them
  • Lying about drugs
  • Avoiding loved ones
  • Avoiding social situations and friends
  • Withdrawing from social situations and hobbies
  • Disorientation
  • Hallucinations
  • Paranoia
  • Weight loss
  • Scabs or bruises on the skin
  • Reduced personal hygiene
  • Extreme itching
  • Wearing long pants and shirts no matter the weather
  • Track marks
  • Regular respiratory infections
  • Slurred speech
  • Dry mouth
  • Apathy
  • Increased sleeping
  • Drug paraphernalia like glass pipes, missing shoelaces, burned spoons, or needles
  • Poor work or school performance

Does Heroin Cause Withdrawal?

Yes, heroin does cause withdrawal. In fact, it causes severe withdrawal. These withdrawal symptoms can last one week or longer, depending on how long you used heroin.

What are the Symptoms of Heroin Withdrawal?

Within a matter of hours after your last dose, you might experience things like:

  • Severe cravings
  • Diarrhea and vomiting
  • Stomach cramps
  • Sweating
  • Muscle pain
  • Restlessness
  • Insomnia
  • Depression
  • Cold flashes
  • Twitching and pain in the bones and joints
  • Mood swings

Long-term regular use can cause serious health problems and symptoms, including:

  • Skin diseases
  • Chronic constipation
  • Impotence or fertility problems
  • Increase risks of lung problems like pneumonia
  • Compromised immune systems and bad nutrition
  • Damage to your blood vessels can cause brain, kidney, liver, and lung issues

Overcoming these symptoms requires professional heroin addiction treatment in Huntington Beach, CA, a qualified facility with the right medical staff.
